title: Research SOTA in agentic TDD, test reduction and provable coverage
description: Survey prior art and current SOTA on agent-driven TDD, test-suite bloat, test-suite reduction/adequacy, and proof/property-based coverage; review ~/repos/proof-skills for reuse. Output is a lore Reference doc that drives the plugin design.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A lore Reference doc summarizes findings with cited sources across agentic TDD, suite reduction/adequacy, and provable coverage
The doc states how each finding shapes the plugin design
proof-skills reuse decision is recorded (use as-is vs specialize)

finalSummary: Four parallel web-research passes (agentic TDD/test bloat; suite reduction & adequacy; provable coverage & formal methods; industry standards incl. ISO 29119, ISTQB v4, DO-178C, ISO 26262, IEC 61508/62304, NASA NPR 7150.2, FDA CSA, DORA, TMMi) plus a proof-skills review. Deliverable docs/reference/state-of-the-art-in-agentic-tdd-and-sustainable-test-suites.md (cited; section 9 maps each finding to a design response; section 8 and ADR-0006 record the reuse decision). Verified: lore check 0 errors.
